errors.text: The proposed intervention is compositional alloying, whereas the target intervention induces chemical short-range order in a fixed-composition random bcc HfNbTaTiZr alloy.
The predicted direction is opposite to the target result: the hypothesis predicts reduced conductivity, while short-range ordering increases lattice thermal conductivity by approximately 12%.
The comparator is internally inconsistent because an alloy cannot have the same composition while simultaneously lacking the added alloying elements.
No prior evidence is supplied despite the request for supporting evidence.
